title: love the look
text: love the look. I really like how these look... really natural and woody almost, with a woody texture... I bought them to place some mini bundt cakes on (about 3" in circumference) and they are the perfect size.  Not too big.. not too small. They are 5" across or close to it, but the flat food area is about 4" which is perfect for my use.  I also bought some 4" dessert forks to go with.  They would be too big for a one-bite appetizer (I can't spell amooz boosh)  in my opinion... but would work for two or three small apps for sure. They appear to be very sturdy.  I will update with any use issues but I think they will work well. In fact, I think I will try some of the larger versions because I really like how they look.
